notes.title: Update 1.11g (Dialog improvements for German version)
notes.content: The update of the German version to 1.11g includes some minor bugfixes, balancing adjustments and a revision of various dialog passages, which should further improve the dialog flow of the German version of the game. The English version was already on 1.11g, including all bugfixes and balancing adjustments.

notes.title: V1.11 (New Game+ and more)
notes.content:
- [b]New Game+[/b] mode is now available 
(after the credits the game will automatically start in New Game+ mode. This will carry over all items, character levels, and sacrifices from the current playthrough into a new playthrough. Character levels will also no longer drop in New Game+ mode due to the "corruption").

- The arguments between Alaine and Celene are now more moderate in many places in the game

- physical attacks in attack stance now cause a bit more damage

- blood recovery on cancelled summons is now equal to the actual summon blood cost

- Summons cost less blood

- Various menu displays optimized (EXP bar incl. bug fix on Lvl99, spell rune menu now shows resistance increases...)

- Various spelling mistakes corrected

- Various mapping errors corrected

- First small adjustment of an end at high humanity (further adjustments concerning high humanity will follow)

notes.title: Patchnotes V1.10a - V1.10e
notes.content:
- Source code optimization to further reduce possible crash causes on some PC configurations.

- All human NPCs now have an indicator of their blood level. This makes it possible to identify whether the currently addressed NPC has already been "bitten".

- The quest log is now quickly accessible via the "L" key, the world map via the "M" key (or Start & Select on the Joypad)

- Balancing adjustments: all enemies have a slightly reduced armor and the player characters have an increased hit chance to make the game feel more balanced between attacks and spells

- The treasure chamber under the store in Hadrin is now accessible as planned

- In the quest "Seed of Evil" there is now a way into the cellar without having to be "evil"

- In the quest "Snail Dilemma" the transformation of the snail now has consequences on the quest progress

- EXP doubled for absorbing the hidden ghosts

- Summons can now be swapped with the same summon to refresh their health points

- The final battle has now a more imposing background

- The NPC "Thorwald" can now be controlled as planned

- The hidden ghost behind the Fortress Ulderin is now accessible

- some smaller mapping errors have been corrected

notes.title: Major Balancing Update V1.08
notes.content:
Some major improvements regarding the game progression and difficulty level

-Enemy-Respawn Option now available in the game (available in Asgars Castle)
- several previously hidden places are now visible from the start (this will help getting progress without having to search the map in the Levels <20)
- Experience from quests increased below Level 50
- Summonings have now ~20% Health
- Traps now reduce Bloodpoints instead of Health when "Auto-Healing" is off
- Using a battle stance in battle doesn't require an additional selection of the character anymore
- Several adjustments of enemy, character and item stats
